title: Chapter 141 Taking The Initiative
content:
Chapter 141 Taking The Initiative

"I will ask the Zerg to help find the wild horses. The Zerg energy coins will be sent to the barracks soon. You must recover your strength as soon as possible."

"If nothing unexpected happens, you will go with the Zerg army tomorrow. We must first eliminate the largest camp of the evil god camp nearby!"

Wu Qing has been focusing on the city of the bear goblins near the alliance territory. Before the camp war broke out, the army of the evil god camp gathered there had nearly 200,000 troops.

Because Wu Qing triggered the camp war in advance, the evil god camp army gathered there was unable to participate in the camp war. With the unexpected defeat of the evil god camp, those troops have been staying.

These days, it has been relatively quiet there. Only a small number of teams transporting supplies and small groups of troops come every day, and no large-scale reinforcements have been found.

Because it is impossible to monitor effectively at night, the information obtained by the Zerg puppies during the day can only be used for reference, and many specific information may be inaccurate.

Wu Qing and the Queen of the Bugs combined various intelligence analyses and concluded that the total number of troops assembled in the city of the Bugbears should be around 300,000, of which the proportion of elite troops was very high.

The commander-in-chief of an army of this size is likely to be the mysterious and powerful High Priest of the Evil God.

Wu Qing guessed that the Evil God camp felt the powerful threat of the Zerg from the camp war, and combined with the relevant intelligence about the Zerg reported by the Bugbears, it was determined that the Zerg's territory was in this area.

The Evil God camp now gathered heavy troops in the city of the Bugbears and turned it into another base camp of the Evil God camp, which was obviously aimed at the Zerg.

This is to give priority to eliminating the Zerg threat and consuming the development potential of the Zerg. The Evil God camp in this area has already raised the threat of the Zerg to the same level as the Tengu clan.

Faced with such a threat, Wu Qing could not remain indifferent. He has been preparing to attack the city of the Bugbears.

Active attack is better than passive attack. Zerg cannot lead the enemy to the Zerg territory for battle, so the Zerg has no advantage in ground defense.

After seeing the strength of the bear goblin high priest and his guard bear goblin dragon knight, Wu Qing postponed the time of attack. With the strength of the Zerg at that time, they could win, but it would be very difficult.

And there is no way to annihilate the enemy. The bear goblin high priest and the bear goblin dragon knight are likely to run away like last time.

In the past two days, thanks to the mysterious enemy's welfare every night, the development of the Zerg has changed dramatically every day. Now Wu Qing has the confidence to eliminate all kinds of interference, annihilate the enemy, and completely eradicate the cancer left by the evil god camp in this area.

The establishment of the Daxia army and the development and construction of the army of each territory of the alliance can increase the chances of winning this active annihilation war.

The various territories of the alliance, taken separately, most of the military strength is not strong. There are several weakest territories, and the number of troops in their territories is estimated to be less than a thousand.

But the territories that joined the alliance have the advantage of being numerous, and there are powerful territories like the five major territories. It is easy for everyone to gather together and gather 200,000 troops.

Like the five major territories and the top territories, they can also produce a lot of elite soldiers who can fight.

As long as they are not afraid of losing troops, these armies can also fight hard battles.

Wu Qing does not need them to fight hard battles, they can just play auxiliary battles, and the hard battles will be left to the Zerg.

After testing several previous wars, Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg found that when bringing an army of the nature of the alliance to participate in the war, under the influence of various factors, as long as the Zerg is responsible for the main battle, the resources harvested by the system are not much different from those without the alliance army.

Perhaps the larger the scale of the war, the more luck can be plundered from the enemy camp, coupled with the gains brought by factors such as increased reputation and development of allies, resulting in Wu Qing's actual gains being almost the same.

This kind of thing that benefits others without harming oneself can certainly be done, and doing so has some potential effects that are continuous, such as the reputation gained by the Zerg, which is an achievement that can continuously bring benefits to Wu Qing.

…

Wu Cong and the other two left. Wu Qing notified the lords of the alliance through the Zerg host to prepare to lead the army to the battle tomorrow morning.

Whether to send troops and how many troops to send are all decided by the lords of the alliance. Wu Qing does not make any requirements.

This is a development opportunity Wu Qing gave to the territories of the alliance. As long as you participate, you will definitely gain a lot.

The more troops you send and the more elite they are, the greater the benefits you can get. This is the rule of this world. Everyone knows it. It depends on how everyone weighs the choice.

Wu Qing produced a batch of Zerg energy coins in the Zerg base underground in the new city of Daxia Territory. He asked the host to send it to Wu Cong, and he quietly returned to the Zerg territory.

If you want to successfully attack the city of the evil god camp tomorrow, there must not be too many problems in the Zerg territory tonight.

It is impossible for the Zerg to make another breakthrough in one day. The genetic sample of the giant ghoul that fits the Zerg is not easy to come across.

If those messy genes are used for research, it will not only waste a lot of resources and time, but also may not produce anything valuable. At this stage, it is not worth the loss.

Facing the unknown enemy tonight, the Zerg can only respond to changes with the same strategy. No matter how the enemy attacks, the Zerg will use the dog sea tactics to deal with it.

This requires a sufficient number of Zerg puppies. Wu Qing thought for a while and decided to add another 100,000 Zerg puppies to increase the number of Zerg puppies to 300,000.

Eighteen thousand Hydralisks and three hundred thousand Zerglings, this is a huge resource consumption, plus the defense buildings that are constantly built as the Zerg territory continues to expand, this resource consumption is like running water.

The Zerg underground territory is constantly adjusting based on the experience of the previous two nights of battle. By dusk, the shape of the entire Zerg underground territory has become like a horizontal gourd.

The expanded original Zerg territory underground base is the lower hemisphere of this gourd. The original connecting channel opened up and merged the two spaces that were strangely excavated last night, becoming the upper hemisphere of this gourd. The middle connection is very wide and is no longer a weak point in the Zerg territory.

The remaining section of the connecting channel connecting the karst cave base is like the narrow mouth of this big gourd. This connecting channel and the entire karst cave base are the weaknesses of the Zerg territory defense.

Wu Qing redeployed his troops. If the battle situation is not good at night, he will decisively give up the karst cave base.

Wu Qing is very confident that the Zerg are defending this gourd-shaped underground territory with all their might. No matter what new tricks the enemy plays, he is ready to use the dog sea tactics to withstand it!
